⤍ Sᴏᴍᴇ Exᴀᴍᴘʟᴇs
Dogecoin, our very own Ethereum, Solana, SHIB (Shiba Inu)

These are examples of come coins that are inflationary, Let's note not all inflationary tokens are worthless.

They just have high chances of being over time, Sol & Eth are healthy you'd agree.

⤍Sᴏ Mᴇᴍᴇs?

Memecoins are a type of coins that originated from jokes and internet memes.

Heard of @dogecoin before? it was the first memecoin created back in 2013 using a Shiba Inu dog as it's mascot.

Fun fact: Dogecoin was created to mock the hype surrounding Bitcoin then https://t.co/jDADafr7Ij
